note: All-stock merger of equals with United Technologies Corporation, completed 2020-04-03. United Technologies was the surviving registrant (CIK 101829) and its name changed to Raytheon Technologies Corporation at closing; Raytheon Company (NYSE: RTN) shares ceased trading and each converted into 2.3348 United Technologies shares.

Name change only — same registrant (CIK 101829), by certificate of amendment effective 2023-07-17. The ticker stayed RTX; the shares traded under the former name through 2023-07-26 and as RTX Corporation from 2023-07-27.

United Technologies completed the Rockwell Collins acquisition on 2018-11-26: "Collins Aerospace was formed through the combination of UTC Aerospace Systems and Rockwell Collins." Collins Aerospace entered the Raytheon Technologies / RTX family through the 2020 merger.

The release names only Rockwell Collins; that this separately-registered award recipient is one of its subsidiaries is OUR inference from the name, not a statement in the source. Listed apart because USAspending registers it as its own recipient family.

Publicly styled a merger of equals; the filing records that Merger Sub merged into L3 on 2019-06-29 and L3 continued as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Harris Corporation, so we record what the filing says.
Harris was the surviving registrant (CIK 202058) and "was renamed 'L3Harris Technologies, Inc.' upon consummation of the Merger"; the ticker moved HRS to LHX.

Harris completed the Exelis merger on 2015-05-29 — four years before the L3 merger, and a separate event from it. Exelis continued as the surviving entity and a wholly-owned Harris subsidiary; implied consideration approximately USD 4.6B.
Northrop Grumman closed the Orbital ATK acquisition on 2018-06-06: "Orbital ATK is now Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems, a new, fourth business sector."
HII completed the acquisition of Alion Science and Technology from Veritas Capital on 2021-08-19, into HII's Technical Solutions division. The release states no purchase price, so neither do we.
Lockheed Martin closed the Sikorsky acquisition on 2015-11-06. Recorded for completeness: USAspending already resolves Sikorsky under the Lockheed Martin family, so this event merges no separate row.
Vectrus was the surviving registrant (CIK 1601548): "In connection with the closing, the Company was renamed V2X, Inc." The stock traded as VEC through 2022-07-07 and as VVX from 2022-07-08.
The release names only the parent, Vectrus, Inc.; that this separately-registered award recipient is the same Vectrus operating business is OUR inference from the name, not a statement in the source.
"Vectrus and Vertex Complete Combination" — the release names the counterparty The Vertex Company; Vertex Aerospace Services Corp. is the recipient name the pre-2022 awards were made under.

Teledyne completed the FLIR acquisition on 2021-05-14; aggregate consideration approximately USD 8.2B including net debt. FLIR now sits in Teledyne's Digital Imaging segment and operates as Teledyne FLIR.

SAIC completed the merger on 2019-01-14 at 0.450 SAIC shares per Engility share and Engility became a wholly-owned SAIC subsidiary; the combined company kept the SAIC name. The release names the acquired registrant Engility Holdings, Inc.; Engility Corporation is the recipient name in the award data.

TransDigm completed the acquisition of all outstanding Esterline stock on 2019-03-14 at USD 122.50 per share; the pro forma exhibit puts the purchase price net of cash acquired at approximately USD 3,923.9M.

HPE separated its Enterprise Services business (Everett Spinco) and "merged it with Computer Sciences Corporation ('CSC') to create DXC Technology" — a combination creating a new company, not a rename of CSC. Pre-merger CSC stockholders held approximately 49.9% of DXC.
